configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Matches this project's default CMake option values exactly -- no FEMFX, no GPU profiler (Jolt and Lua are on). The smallest, fastest build; only kke_demo/imgui_demo/rmlui_demo and the test suite.

configurePresets.name: everything
configurePresets.description: Every optional piece this engine has, on at once: FEMFX physics, GPU profiling, and Lua scripting. This is what most people actively developing the engine itself want -- see INSTRUCTIONS.md for the system packages this needs first.

configurePresets.name: everything-release
configurePresets.description: Same as 'everything', but RelWithDebInfo (optimized, still has symbols) in its own build-release/ directory. Use this to judge performance -- the Debug build compiles engine code at -O0, which is fine for stepping through code but not representative of what a player would see. FEMFX itself is always optimized either way (see external/FEMFX/CMakeLists.txt).
